# Smile Arizona Dentistry

> Premier cosmetic and family dentistry practice in Scottsdale, AZ offering advanced restorative, cosmetic, and aesthetic treatments led by Dr. Beth Vander Schaaf.

Smile Arizona Dentistry is a comprehensive dental practice serving the Scottsdale area with expertise in cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, sedation dentistry, and advanced laser treatments. The practice combines family dentistry fundamentals with cutting-edge aesthetic and restorative procedures.
